disposition_reason: Reprint of data: the 2018 Konya urban colonies (L1 to L4, same coordinates, same methods) were first reported per location by Bayir and Aygun 2022; this paper pools them (e.g. pollen Cd 0.0105, Pb 0.146 mg/kg; honey Cd 0.0065, Pb 0.113 mg/kg) for PCA and LDA, so its values are not extracted as independent findings.
disposition_locator: Material and Methods p. 50-51; Table 1 p. 51

study.design: Re-analysis (PCA and LDA) of honey bee, bee pollen and honey metals from 20 colonies at four urban-fringe Konya sites
study.origin: Konya, Turkey; locations L1 to L4
study.period_text: 2018; pollen May and June; honey harvested 15 to 20 July (as printed)
study.qa: Blank and NIST SRM 1547 peach leaves per run; recoveries not reported

unresolved: Sites, colonies, year and method match Bayir and Aygun 2022 (preprint 10.21203/rs.3.rs-1302296/v1), which the authors cite as 'our previous study'; pooled Table 1 means equal the averages of that preprint's L1 to L4 means, so the data are a reprint.
Honey harvest window printed as July 15 to July 20, while the earlier preprint printed 15 July to 15 August.
Table 1 reports mean ± standard error (X̄ ± Sx) in mg/kg for honey bee, bee pollen and honey.
